module.purpose: This client page initiates SAML single sign-on using tenant and product identifiers, while redirecting hosted deployments back to the standard login page.
module.summary: The module defines a client-rendered authentication entry point. It receives server-derived SAML configuration, redirects hosted Cal.com instances to the regular login route, and otherwise invokes NextAuth's SAML provider with the supplied tenant and product values and a root callback URL. The component renders no visible UI.
module.businessContext: This supports enterprise SAML authentication for self-hosted Cal.com deployments. Failure prevents users from starting SSO or may route hosted users through an unsupported authentication path.
classes: SSODirectPageProps (~L14): Server-derived properties required to initiate direct SAML authentication
functions: Page (~L15-36): Redirects hosted instances and initiates the SAML authentication flow
systemCapabilities: Return authenticated users to the root route

network: Calls NextAuth signIn with the SAML provider to initiate external authentication.
